A perpetual night of catastrophe, terror descends, and strange phenomena abound! A young man, Wang Ye, is inexplicably chosen by the "Mysterious Post Office" to serve as a "ghost messenger," awakening his special powers and repeatedly embroiling himself in dangerous and paranormal phenomena. Witness how Wang Ye pushes the envelope, dispelling the mysteries and igniting the flames of humanity's survival amidst the terrifying darkness.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

199410.description:
Chen Changsheng, a young man of mysterious origins, is prophesied to die before the age of twenty due to his unique constitution. Determined to defy fate, he follows his master’s orders and travels to the Divine Capital of the human realm with a marriage contract in hand. His goal is to win first place in the highest-level Grand Imperial Examination, thereby earning the right to enter the Tomb of Heavenly Books to study the steles and seek a way to extend his life. In the Divine Capital, the marriage contract draws him into complex power struggles involving the Saintess Xu Yourong. Soon, an even greater crisis emerges: the forces of the demon race begin stirring in secret, plotting to overthrow the human race. Relying on his vast knowledge, Chen Changsheng makes his debut at the Ivy Banquet, then goes on to claim first place in the Grand Imperial Examination, gaining entry to the Tomb of Heavenly Books. There, he not only comprehends profound cultivation techniques but also uncovers a connection between his own origins and a massive conspiracy from years past. After leaving the Tomb of Heavenly Books, Chen Changsheng enters the Zhou Garden secret realm with companions such as Xu Yourong, Luoluo, and Tang Thirty-Six. Inside the Zhou Garden, they clash head-on with the demon race. Chen Changsheng ultimately inherits Zhou Dufu's legacy and uncovers the shocking possibility that he is the Crown Prince Zhaoming. This revelation thrusts him into the eye of the storm…

(Source: iQ)

199590.description:
Matsurika, a female officer in the Inner Palace, had a little special skill, and that was "a better memory" than others. One day, she accepted a request to become a practice partner for a marriage meeting of a certain son of a distinguished family. However, the one who appeared was the Emperor, Hakuyou, who wanted to try having a marriage meeting?! And interested in Matsurika's special skill, Hakuyou even said, "For now, go and pass the civil exam"...?!

A Chinese-style Cinderella story between an emperor and a girl!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

199597.description:
Welcome to Kindergarten Noir, an exclusive school catering to children of the global elite. Rita, one of the teachers, has been on the hunt for a boyfriend but has had absolutely zero luck so far. One day, an assassin comes after one of the children...and he’s totally dreamy?! Dive into this action-packed rom-com as it unfolds inside the world’s “safest” kindergarten!

(Source: MANGA PLUS)

title.native: 彼女、お借りします 第5期

199029.description:
With his family's traditional spa resort trip underway, Kazuya Kinoshita has been unable to take his relationship further with his rental girlfriend Chizuru Ichinose. After receiving mixed signals from her, Kazuya comes to the decision to finally end their long-lasting facade upon returning to Tokyo.

Meanwhile, Kazuya's ex-girlfriend Mami Nanami is willing to do anything to break Chizuru's pretense with him. As Mami abruptly causes the couple's fake relationship to collapse in front of his family and friends, Kazuya will have to take immediate action if he wants to save his social life.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

199340.description:
"Actually, I’m Touko Kirishima."

The audience erupted in excitement upon learning that the true identity of the mysterious, wildly popular internet singer was none other than the nation’s favorite actress, Mai Sakurajima. The scene was exactly the same as the dream Sakuta Azusagawa had seen on Christmas Eve.

Starting with Mai’s shocking confession on April 1, the impossible events that everyone once dreamed of keep happening one after another. The social media hashtag "#Yumemiru," where dreams come true, has vanished, and as Sakuta struggles with the disconnect between the reality before him and his own perception, he receives a message from a version of himself in an alternate reality.

―Stop Touko Kirishima,
―Before reality is rewritten.

To restore the world to its original state, Sakuta sets out to find Touko Kirishima. This is a story about overcoming the "Adolescent Syndrome".

(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

199112.description:
"I want to learn to love myself—just the way I am!" Renako Amaori, a former gloomy and socially awkward girl, reinvented herself for high school and successfully made her debut. She even managed to join the top-tier popular group... only to be suddenly confessed to by two of its brightest stars?! One is the school’s ultimate prince, Mai Oduka. The other, the beloved angel of the campus, Ajisai Sena. There’s no way she can handle both their affections—no freaking way!

While still struggling to give them an answer, Renako agrees to help her friend Kaho by joining a cosplay event. It’s the perfect excuse to delay her reply… or so she thought. But as she witnesses Kaho's passion firsthand, something begins to stir inside her. What is it that she truly wants? What is she truly searching for?

Can she really not become someone’s lover? Or has that "no freaking way"... not been so impossible after all?

(Source: REMOW)

Note: The anime first premiered in theaters across Japan on November 21, 2025. It was later split into 5 parts on TV, labelled as episodes 13-17.

Misaki has often felt the urge to break free from everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere far away. Even though she doesn’t yet know what she wants to become, she longs to find something she can truly be passionate about.

At the start of a new chapter on a lively campus, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Research Club—known as the “Tetsuryo Club.” As her world unfolds along the railway lines, Misaki’s heart begins to race with excitement!

As TETSUDOU MUSUME celebrates its 20th anniversary, the Tetsuryo Club sets off on a journey through the world where the Railway Girls work, in search of moments of wonder.

It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it’s amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they’ve never felt more alive.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Once the Demon King, now a shut-in NEET—Ryuusei Narukami’s second life is anything but peaceful! When Meteor Hanaori, the Hero who once defeated him, suddenly returns as a normal high school girl, his world is thrown into chaos. Determined to change, Ryuusei reenters society as a teacher and ends up teaching at her school! Their explosive reunion reignites the past—and sparks an unexpected love!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Yi Feng traveled to the Xianjiang Continent. Since he was born without spiritual roots, he could only survive by relying on the "essential life skills" given by the system. Little did he know that in the eyes of those practitioners, his strength was already at the god level, and his every move affected the entire pattern of the Xianjiang Continent. Yi Feng easily resolved many crises without knowing it, which also brought about many passionate and hilarious scenes, and brought new opportunities and choices to the people living on this continent.

199588.description:
Meet Takuya Seo, an otaku who sits behind the popular gals in class, Ijichi and Amane. Since they're people from different "castes," you wouldn't expect them to have much in common. But when their worlds collide over a borrowed eraser, Takuya slips up about his favorite anime, and Amane...is rather quick to correct him. She says she's not a fan, but her familiarity with the series suggests otherwise. Could she be...a fellow geek?!

(Source: Yen Press)

Iori's college shenanigans head overseas! Just as he's finally starting to get the hang of university life, crashing at his uncle's dive shop while balancing the booze-fueled antics of his diving club, Iori's cousin enlists him to help run a new dive shop in Palau. Between crystal-clear dives and his diving group that can't resist partying it up and stripping down, Iori's in for a wild summer.

Luck, an S-rank mage in the hero’s party, makes a last stand against the Demon King to save his companions. When he finally returns victorious, ten years have passed, and the world praises him as a legendary hero who died in battle. Unable to reclaim his former life, Luck conceals his identity and begins again as “Lock,” an F-rank adventurer forging a future in a world that moved on without him.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

199221.description:
After reconciling with Dr. Xeno, Senkuu Ishigami is close to realizing his long-held dream: the space mission to the Moon is finally underway. While Dr. Xeno begins the development of their rocket's engine, Senkuu's team continues navigating through continents and seas in search of essential resources and people to assemble the necessary infrastructure for the mission as well as revive the entire human population.

Meanwhile, the enigmatic Whyman continues to cast its shadow over Earth from the Moon. But with the combined might of humanity finally coming together, it is only a matter of time before Senkuu and the others confront Whyman and get the answers that have eluded humanity for centuries.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

199547.description:
For centuries, the deadly arts have been perfected by those known as the Masters. Among them, the Poison Masters of the Five Great Families hold the most fearsome power and influence. Hikaru Gero, heir to the Poison Masters’ Gero Family, has lived his entire life in the underworld, far removed from love or marriage. But when the Gero Family head decrees that Hikaru’s sister must bear an heir to preserve the bloodline—by force if necessary—Hikaru resolves to protect her at all costs. It is then that Hikaru encounters Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler who becomes the target of his latest job. Realizing that the only way of solving the family succession problem and protecting his sister is through marriage, Hikaru impulsively asks Mei for help in finding a bride.

(Source: EMOTION Label Channel)

199448.description:
Special episodes of Lord of Mysteries, taking place in season 1. Covering important scenes skipped after the end credits in Episode 10, as included:

City of Silver (Episode 1): Above the undying gray fog, Klein Moretti, the enigmatic The Fool, presided over the Tarot Club when a new, distant prayer echoed through the mists. Reaching across the veil, he summoned Derrick Berg from the City of Silver—a cursed bastion trapped within the Forsaken Land of God. Through Derrick’s haunting tales, the grim history of this sunless city was unveiled. Seeking salvation for his people, Derrick pledged his soul to The Fool’s grace. From the twenty-two Major Arcana, he chose his mantle: "The Sun."

The Marked Hunt (Episodes 2 and 3): The gathering then turned to matters of blood and ambition. "The Hanged Man," Alger Wilson, proposed a high-stakes exchange. He sought the head of Qilangos, one of the infamous seven Pirate Admirals, and tasked "Justice," Audrey Hall, with leveraging her noble influence in Backlund to hunt the wind-blessed killer.

In the foggy streets of the Loen capital, Audrey’s quest led her to the Beyonder duo, Fors Wall and Xio Derecha. As the web tightened around the Admiral, Klein sought the intervention of his mentor, the mysterious Mr. Azik. By weaving together the threads of divinity, ancient power, and mortal cunning, The Fool ensured the Tarot Club’s first great triumph: the fall of Qilangos.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

199408.description:
Elizabeth Leiston, daughter of the influential prime minister, is a picture-perfect lady on the path to becoming the future queen of the Kingdom of Haldoria. But her life takes a sudden turn for the worst when her fiancé makes a show of publicly calling off their engagement. Soon after, he throws her in jail and starts spreading nasty rumors about her. The encouragement Elizabeth receives from her loyal waiting maid, Mireille, and her inner fury are all she needs to reconsider her goals. Why should she continue devoting herself to a country that doesn’t respect her when she can trample over it instead? She will get even with those who wronged her and bring down the damned kingdom, even if it’s the last thing she does! Luckily, Elizabeth is no damsel in distress and has seven powerful magic grimoires she won’t hesitate to use. Get ready because this ruthless lady is out for blood!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

This is the tale of a well-known cartoonist who rose to fame thanks to his comic book.B.K. But after several years, he ran out of ideas and had to rely solely on abandoning his characters in order to draw attention. He was drawn into the realm of B. King as Wang Xiaoming after receiving an enigmatic phone call one day. As a result, Wang Xiaoming, who now possesses the ideas of the "creator," sets out on a fantastical journey that might be summed up as "God's shortcut, one step to heaven."

(Source: Bilibili TV)

199430.description:
Ell, the strongest dragon in the Demon Realm, wants one thing: to die, so he can relax in the afterlife. Unfortunately, that’s easier said than done. After accidentally offing yet another hero, Ell has an idea. If no warrior can slay him, he’ll just raise one who can! After meeting the magician Lafi, Ell begins raising her son, Dino, for this purpose. So begins his hardest quest yet, parenthood.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

199449.description:
When Wen Yifan returned to her hometown for work, she unexpectedly ran into the rumored "First-Class Handsome Guy" at a bar. However, she soon discovered that he was Sang Yan, someone she had hurt and rejected in high school. In a twist of fate, these two individuals who could never get along found themselves constantly crossing paths. They even ended up renting the same unit by chance and becoming housemates. With unspoken feelings buried deep within, strong emotions begin to stir...

Let's see how Sang Yan, the "Peak Ideal Boyfriend," interprets and expresses his profound affection and sweet love!

(Source: INKR)

199006.description:
"Fortune and Misfortune are two sides of the same coin?! Reverse any adversary and cease redemption!!"

Siegbert is reborn after an unfortunate accident in his previous life. His new family is warm and welcoming... so much so it seems as though he may no longer be an unlucky person. In this world, he can finally live a quiet, peaceful life... or so he thought. It seems that he actually holds an insanely high luck stat in this new world...?

"Every chance is a manifestation of good fortune. If you can cease the chances, your wishes shall be granted..." Conquering each "chance" granted by his good fortune, will he now cease redemption on the generational legacy this family has yet to fulfill?!

After a botched robbery attempt leads to their banishment, a clumsy pig demon and his toad companion hatch an ambitious scheme: impersonate the legendary monk Tang San Zang and his disciples to claim the glory of the sacred scrolls. Recruiting a chatterbox weasel and a cowardly gorilla to complete their ragtag troupe, the quartet embarks on a chaotic journey across a world filled with dangerous rivals and mistaken identities. Their charade takes a perilous turn when they stumble into the path of a sinister adversary plotting to consume the monk for immortality. Forced to confront their own limitations, the group must decide if they are content playing pretend or if they possess the true mettle of heroes.

199405.description:
The young Qin Feng, hailed as a once-in-a-millennium prodigy in the Wuji Nation, was framed and his entire family was wiped out, leaving him alone. After his martial veins were crippled, he was cast into a small, remote sect to fend for himself. Determined to become stronger and seek revenge, he endured constant bullying, often protected by his kind-hearted Second Senior Sister, who shared a common fate. Unbeknownst to everyone, Qin Feng had already secretly embarked on the arduous path of physical cultivation. Upon learning that three members of his sect were eligible to train at the Tiandao Academy, and with the spots already secured, he broke free from his humiliation. Upon being humiliated once again by the sect's prodigy, Yun Tianyu, he revealed his physical cultivation identity and violently assaulted Yun Tianyu, shocking everyone. Afterwards, he took the initiative, repeatedly teaching Yun Tianyu a lesson, openly challenging the protective Great Elder, and vowing to get a spot in Tiandao Academy, because only in this way could he become stronger. To prevent his apprentice from being humiliated, the two sides finally agreed to a duel in seven days. The winner would receive a spot to practice in Tiandao Academy. During this process, Yun Tianyu broke through the realm and unexpectedly became the Son of God. He was sought after and everyone thought he would win easily. Even the Second Senior Sister tried to persuade him to give up and offered to give him her spot, but Qin Feng refused. In a few days, Qin Feng also received the saint's inheritance. While shouldering the responsibility of saving the human race, he began to secretly practice hellishly.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

199486.description:
Follows Nekotarou, a cat from Kagoshima who aims to unify the country.

(Source: Anime News Network)

199592.description:
Keiko Sahara, an office worker whose hobby is designing cute gel nails, is sent to a world where people's magic abilities come from their nail art. After a magic nail artist notices her ability, she becomes his apprentice!

(Source: TOKYOPOP)
synonyms: Apprentice Nail Artist in a Foreign Land

title.english: Apprentice Nail Artist in a Foreign Land

199603.description: On the way to an important gathering by train, the Princess Teeniepings suddenly disappeared without a trace! To make matters even more mysterious, a Legend Teenieping appears in a mirror before Romi. Together with the new Royal Teeniepings, a grand mission begins to catch the Princess Teeniepings!
